question: Codex Selden / Codex Añute
answer: The Codex Selden is a very detailed piece of writing, it is meant to be read in a certain order, gives names, status, locations, time, actions, etc. and it can all be understood as a cohesive storyline. It doesn’t have a single written words but they give immense amounts of detail that give us insight into the values of the pre-colonial city-states.
